budget_items.what_was_said: Warrants for the period were presented for approval.

budget_items.topic: Salary line transfer: guidance/maintenance to substitute lines
budget_items.what_was_said: Funds moved from an elementary guidance counselor salary line (resignation) and partial maintenance salary savings to cover heavily used substitute lines at Turkey Hill and the high school special education program.
Funds moved from a fire safety/furniture repair line to vehicle repair maintenance to cover an unanticipated flex plate replacement on the 2012 Ford F250.

budget_items.topic: Contracted services transfer for Comcast/e-rate billing
budget_items.what_was_said: Funds moved from general supplies (Turkey Hill) and tech expense lines to contracted services to resolve a Comcast billing deficit pending e-rate credits.

Funds moved from the business manager and HR director salary lines, plus salary reserve, to the business office and assistant secretary salary lines to cover expanded duties across several district-office roles.
Madigan Family Foundation funded the continuation of the scholarship for a 2026 graduating senior.
Check to be deposited into the Turkey Hill Elementary gift account.
Business manager recommended raising the flat student activity fee rather than splitting it into a base and expanded tier, citing administrative cost and a wish not to discourage participation.

budget_items.topic: Turkey Hill MSBA reimbursement rate and construction costs
budget_items.what_was_said: Business manager compared today's MSBA reimbursement rate and per-square-foot costs to those at the time the high school was built, to frame renovation vs. new-construction options for Turkey Hill.
A member questioned whether the commonly cited renovation figure understates the true cost if the building must remain a school under MSBA rules long-term.
New three-year paraprofessional agreement lists cost-of-living increases for FY26, FY27 and FY28, on top of a restructured, now-salaried pay schedule replacing hourly time sheets.
Remaining class account funds donated to the high school secretaries' annual gift card drive for students in need.
Staff compiled entitlement and competitive grants for approval, including a possible new Title III consortium grant with North Middlesex that may not be funded next year; no matching funds required.

budget_items.topic: State FY26 budget aid and reimbursement provisions
budget_items.what_was_said: Chair summarized House-passed state budget provisions affecting transportation and special-education circuit-breaker reimbursement rates and local earmarks for Lunenburg.

budget_items.topic: Additional state aid for FY26 override situation
budget_items.what_was_said: Committee noted an additional appropriation already received and expressed cautious optimism for further state funds still subject to conference committee negotiations.

decisions.decision: Bus fee policy (3601.1) will be reworded to measure distance portal-to-portal per state law rather than as-the-crow-flies, reworked by the policy subcommittee, and brought back for a first read.
Committee members will send Carol Arshambo their high/medium/low priority ratings on the master planning committee's school-facilities wish list within about a week.

Next meeting set for May 21 (hybrid, middle high school, first meeting of the new committee/reorg); following meeting June 4 at town hall will include retiree recognition for three retiring high school staff.

minutes.headline: School Committee appointed Jodie Fortuna as the next superintendent, replacing retiring Dr. Burnham.
minutes.summary: The committee said farewell to three outgoing members, then voted 4-1 to appoint Jodie Fortuna as Lunenburg's next superintendent, subject to contract negotiation. It also approved a raised student activity fee, a new paraprofessional contract, the Turkey Hill ADA study, several budget transfers, grants, and an advertising policy, while debating the select board's refusal to put the override to a ballot and tabling the budget task force charge for the incoming committee.

what_happened.line: The committee voted 4-1 to appoint Jodie Fortuna as the next superintendent, pending contract negotiation.
Members debated the select board's refusal to put the override on a special-election ballot, with no resolution.
A new three-year paraprofessional contract, with cost-of-living increases and a shift to a salaried schedule, was accepted.
Several line-item budget transfers moved money between salary and maintenance accounts to cover substitute pay, a vehicle repair and office duties.
The budget task force charge was tabled until the next school committee is seated after the May 21 reorganization.

why_it_matters: The superintendent appointment sets district leadership through contract negotiation, a process residents will see finalized in coming meetings.
The unresolved override-ballot dispute between the school committee and select board affects how a funding question would reach voters.
The paraprofessional contract and the internal budget transfers touch staffing costs and coverage in classrooms and buses that families rely on.
watch_next: Outcome of superintendent contract negotiation with Jodie Fortuna
May 21 hybrid meeting: first meeting of the newly reorganized committee

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree closely on the substance of nearly every vote, transfer amount, and figure — most differences are caption artifacts (misheard names, dropped digit grouping) rather than real disputes. The one thing to check: our minutes record an explicit unanimous vote to appoint Jodie Fortuna, while the official minutes' own tally of the final round shows 4–1 (Archambault still for Brent Conway), and our minutes note an abstention on tabling the budget task force charge that the official minutes do not record.
